description: The Lignum settlements have requested a scout to map the 'Shattered Peaks'. Suzuka stands at the trailhead, her light travel gear replaced by a sturdy hunting coat. If she can chart the pathless wild, she will be recognized as a true Wind-Chaser.

choices.blocked_message: Requires Suzuka to have the Pathfinder trait.
choices.message_success: Suzuka ignores the human trails, leaping across ravines with mechanical precision. She is officially designated a Wind-Chaser. (+8 Agility, +5 Combat, +2 Energy Regen)
choices.message_failure: The terrain is too much. Suzuka returns exhausted. She needs days of rest to recover her strength.
